string.text: {=str_comment_vassal_introduces_self.akan.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}, and I am honored to serve you.

{=str_comment_vassal_introduces_self.akan_honor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. My oath to your banner is my bond — I do not give it lightly, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}.
{=str_comment_vassal_introduces_self.akan_valor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. You will find no fiercer sword arm in your service, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}.

{=str_comment_vassal_introduces_self.akan_calculating.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. Alliance with you is sound strategy. I trust it will prove so for us both, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_honor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. My word is my only currency — spend it wisely.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_valor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. I have bled for these lands. Do not make me regret that.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_mercy.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. Come in peace and you will find it returned.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_calculating.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. Let us be direct — what do you want, and what will it cost me?
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_uncharitable.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. I have little time and less patience. Speak your purpose.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_female.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. You stand in the presence of a Maroon matriarch — mind your manners.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_female_mercy.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. My hearth is open to those who come in friendship.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self.akan_female_honor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}. My people have survived worse than you — I ask only that you give me reason to trust.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan_honor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. We have kept our honour when others cast theirs aside.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan_mercy.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. We do not forget those who showed us kindness.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan_boasting.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. You would do well to remember both names.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan_boasting_cruel.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Those who crossed us have learned what that means.

{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan_elder.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, Za of the {CLAN_NAME}. My father's father fought for these mountains. I will not surrender a stone of them.
{=str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan.akan_elder_honor.text}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, Za of the {CLAN_NAME}. Sankofa — we look back so we do not lose our way forward.
{=str_liege_title.akan.text}rightful Za of the Maroon
{=str_liege_title_female.akan.text}rightful Za of the Maroon
{=str_comment_player_is_captured.akan.text}You fought well. We did not seek this quarrel, but you left us no choice. Rest — we are not savages.
{=str_comment_player_is_captured.akan_cruel.text}Did you truly believe you could ride into Maroon lands and leave unscathed? You will have time in that cell to reconsider.
{=str_comment_player_is_captured.akan_honor.text}A warrior deserves a warrior's treatment. You have that, at least, from me.
{=str_comment_player_is_captured.akan_mercy.text}You are unharmed — I have given orders. I hope you will remember that when the time comes to speak of us to others.
{=str_comment_enemy_defeated.akan.text}The mountains demanded a price. We paid it. Now let us see to our wounded.
{=str_comment_enemy_defeated.akan_valor.text}We fought as our ancestors taught — without fear, without hesitation. This victory belongs to every soul that bled for Maroon freedom.
{=str_comment_enemy_defeated.akan_calculating.text}We chose our ground, we chose our moment. This was never in doubt.
{=str_comment_enemy_defeated.akan_cruel.text}Let word of this spread. The next column that marches into these hills will think twice.
{=str_comment_meet_after_victory.akan.text}A decisive victory. The Adinkra say 'Aya' — the fern endures. So must we.
{=str_comment_meet_after_victory.akan_honor.text}Well fought. Honour demands I say so plainly — you have earned respect this day.
{=str_comment_meet_after_victory.akan_calculating.text}The outcome was the correct one. I trust our arrangement remains intact.
{=str_comment_ask_for_peace.akan.text}The Maroons have never sought war for its own sake. We fight because we must. If there is a path through words, I would walk it.
{=str_comment_ask_for_peace.akan_mercy.text}Enough lives have been spent. Let us speak of what a lasting peace might look like for both our peoples.
{=str_comment_ask_for_peace.akan_calculating.text}Continuing this costs us both. I am prepared to discuss terms — if you are prepared to be reasonable.
{=str_comment_lord_answers_hostile.akan.text}You are riding on Maroon land. State your business, and state it plainly.
{=str_comment_lord_answers_hostile.akan_valor.text}I have not run from a fight in forty years. I will not start now. Choose your next words carefully.
{=str_comment_lord_answers_hostile.akan_calculating.text}I know what you are doing. I know why. And I know exactly how this ends if you do not stand down.
{=str_comment_lord_answers_hostile.akan_cruel.text}The last man who challenged me this way is no longer a concern. Yours is a short road.
{=str_comment_reaction_to_villain.akan.text}Word of your deeds travels faster than you do. Do not expect a warm welcome in these mountains.
{=str_comment_reaction_to_villain.akan_honor.text}We built our freedom on the principle that no one owns another. What you have done is an affront to everything the Maroons stand for.
{=str_comment_reaction_to_villain.akan_calculating.text}I am cataloguing what you have done. Debts are not forgotten here.
{=str_comment_reaction_to_hero.akan.text}There are few in Calradia I would call worthy of respect. You are closer to that list than most.
{=str_comment_reaction_to_hero.akan_honor.text}What you did was right. Simple as that. I will not pretend otherwise.
{=str_comment_reaction_to_hero.akan_mercy.text}Kindness is rarely repaid in kind in this world. The Maroons remember those who break that pattern.
{=str_comment_lord_greets_friend.akan.text}Akwaaba — you are welcome among us. Sit, eat, tell me what the roads are saying.
{=str_comment_lord_greets_friend.akan_generous.text}Good to see you riding these roads again. My cook has prepared more than we can eat — come, join us.
{=str_comment_can_you_join_faction.akan.text}The Maroons do not take oaths lightly, and we do not release them lightly. Think carefully before you bind yourself to us — or before you leave.
{=str_comment_defect_from_faction.akan.text}You are leaving. I will not grovel. But know that a soldier's worth is measured in loyalty as much as in skill.
